archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) mixed with Light/Earthy surfaces
design_philosophy: A modern, professional consulting-firm aesthetic inspired by Deloitte and Baker Tilly. Features confident whitespace, sharp accents, strict geometric grid alignments, bold section numbering, and a 'light and fresh' color palette using the existing Navy and Antique Gold brand colors.

typography.font_substitution_note: User requested 'Calibre' for content. Calibre is a commercial font by Klim Type Foundry. We are substituting it with 'Public Sans' (a free Google Font) which perfectly captures the neutral, structural, and corporate geometric feel of Calibre.

hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#152A47] font-heading

layout_and_spacing.general: Confident whitespace. Use generous padding (p-12, p-16, p-24) to create a premium, uncrowded feel.
layout_and_spacing.grid: Strict, clean columns. Left-align text blocks by default to ensure scannability and structural authority.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_dividers: Use 1px solid borders (border-navy/10) for structural separation. Use thin gold lines (border-t border-[#C9A059]/30) to divide major sections.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Keep corners sharp or minimally rounded (rounded-none or rounded-sm) to match corporate consulting aesthetics (avoid large, bubbly radiuses).

graphics_and_accents.description: To add a 'tinge of graphics' while remaining light and fresh, use subtle background SVG patterns (dots, grids, diagonal hatching) in pale gray or 5% gold. Add floating abstract glass/geometric images sparingly as accents.

image_urls.description: Abstract elegant glass curve. Use as a subtle background graphic overlay for hero or CTA sections.
Architectural low-angle glass building. Excellent for the Enterprise Portal header, about page, or large hero backgrounds with an overlay.
Two businessmen discussing strategies. Perfect for the Learning Paths, Consulting Academy feature section, or Enterprise CTA.

instructions_to_main_agent.css_variables_setup: In `/app/frontend/src/index.css`, update the CSS variables. Set primary to Navy (#152A47), secondary to Gold (#C9A059), background to Ivory (#F9F9F8). Implement the Tailwind utility classes mapping to these variables.
instructions_to_main_agent.font_setup: In `/app/frontend/tailwind.config.js`, update the font family. Set 'sans' to `['Public Sans', 'sans-serif']` and 'heading' to `['Tahoma', 'Verdana', 'sans-serif']`.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: CRITICAL: Ensure all interactive elements retain or add `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_customization: Modify existing Shadcn components to use `rounded-sm` instead of larger default roundings. Remove heavy drop shadows; prefer `shadow-sm` and 1px borders to mimic Deloitte's sharp, confident corporate layout.
instructions_to_main_agent.file_type_note: Ensure you are editing `.js` and `.jsx` files, not `.tsx`.
